papers.title: Efficient Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction for Real-World Acoustic Scenes
papers.desc: Streaming audio-visual target speaker extraction (AVTSE) is essential for latency-sensitive applications.

papers.title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
papers.desc: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input.

papers.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
papers.desc: Robot foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, motivating low-cost offline proxies for model capability.

papers.title: RealCLI: Toward a Unified Evaluation of Human-Agent Collaboration for CLI Agents
papers.desc: Command-line interface (CLI) agents increasingly execute longer-horizon tasks, yet existing benchmarks either assume that user instructions remain fixed throughout execution or evaluate task outcomes without capturing runtime collaboration quality.

papers.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
papers.desc: Agentic services alternate between model inference on clustered GPUs and external tools on distributed CPUs.

papers.title: TauIndianBankBench: Procedure-Aware, Action-Oriented Evaluation of Tool-Using Conversational Agents
papers.desc: Many Indian banks serve customers through FAQ pages and scripted chatbots.

papers.title: Amortizing Sequential Experimental Design in Reasoning LLMs
papers.desc: Despite their extensive pretraining knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, large language models (LLMs) struggle to adaptively gather information in experimental design tasks.

papers.title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
papers.desc: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable.

papers.title: Self-Assessment Reinforcement Learning for Search-State Awareness in Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
papers.desc: Recent advances in search agents have enabled large language models to tackle complex tasks by retrieving and synthesizing external information.

papers.title: Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks
papers.desc: As frontier language models grow increasingly capable and autonomous, independent third-party evaluations are critical for characterizing their systemic safety risks.

papers.title: CausGround: Causal Interaction Grounding for Adaptive Embodied Planning
papers.desc: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promising reasoning capabilities, but reliable physical interaction requires planning that accounts for when actions are executable and how they change the world.

papers.title: AdaPRA: Process Reward Agents with Adaptive Rubrics for Data Science
papers.desc: Data science agents can automate end-to-end machine learning workflows, yet they remain far from competitive on human leaderboards.

papers.title: Quaternion Approximate Networks for Enhanced Image Classification and Oriented Object Detection
papers.desc: This paper introduces Quaternion Approximate Networks (QUAN), a novel deep learning framework that leverages quaternion algebra for rotation equivariant image classification and object detection.

papers.title: HuGe: Scaling Humanoid Generalist Vision-Language-Action Models with Egocentric Experience
papers.desc: Extending Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) to humanoid robots requires coordinated whole-body control and diverse demonstrations that are costly to collect in real-world scenarios.

papers.title: OmniSpectra: A Unified Foundation Model for Universal Spectra Representation Learning
papers.desc: Standard sequence models encode position by token rank rather than physical coordinate, typically forcing practitioners to destructively resample continuous physical signals such as spectra observed across heterogeneous instruments.
